newsitem.title: CHINA: Hainan Airlines to list 71 mln B shares Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Hainan Airlines to list 71 mln B shares Thursday.

text.p: Hainan Airlines Co Ltd will list its initial public offering of 71 million foreign currency B shares on the Shanghai Stock Exchange on Thursday, a company statement said on Tuesday.
The shares issued early last week priced at 3.90 yuan, equivalent to $0.47 per share, a company prospectus has said.
The proceeds from the share issue will be used to buy three Boeing Co 767s over the next two years, the prospectus said.
After the issue, the company would have a total of 471.16 million shares outstanding, of which B shares would account for 15 percent, it said.

The remaining shares included 240.12 million share, or 51 percent, held by domestic institutions, 100.04 million, or 21.3 percent, held by American Aviation Investment and 60 million shares owned by company staff, it said.
J&A Securities Co Ltd was the main underwriter, it added.

The company was also planning to issue 17.53 million A shares before the end of 1997 for listing on the Shanghai bourse, the prospectus said, adding this had already been approved by the Hainan securities administration office.

The company reaped 89.076 million yuan net profit in 1996 based on international accounting standards, a massive increase from 38.589 million yuan in 1995, it said, adding that the company forecast its 1997 net profit to be no less than 140 million yuan.
